summary: Approved releases now install themselves overnight once you have run the install with this release, verified and checked.

new.title: Approved updates install automatically
new.text: Each night your install now installs a release Invardia approved for you, after verifying it. If any step fails, nothing changes and it tries again the next night.
new.action: Run the install once with this release to switch on automatic installs; until then updates are only checked.

new.title: Updates use limited, separate rights
new.text: The update runs with its own rights, limited to your install only, and each step is reported to Invardia as it happens.

fixes.title: Database setup works for more installers
fixes.text: An installer without directory read rights no longer falls back to the old database setup.
